sull_recover_items_generic_response.m: I'm sorry, I have not. In fact, this is the first that I am hearing about it.

sullengard_matpat.m: Hello there, kid. Happy 20th beer celebration.
r: Do you know where Defy is?
I'm looking into the armory break-in and robbery and I am wondering if you saw or know anything about it?

sullengard_matpat_3.m: I don't know, kid. Others are also looking for him and his crew. I'm still busy taking care of my firstborn child.

sullengard_matpat_4.m: We should find him or else what shall we do?

sullengard_matpat_5.m: More importantly, how could I raise my firstborn child without the share to buy expensive foods and pay high rents here?
r: Calm down. I will find a way to help you.

sullengard_matpat_6.m: Thank you. You are my only hope here. I don't trust those unlawful Feygard soldiers. You should talk to the head of the Thieves' Guild about this.

Thieves04.10: Umar told me to visit Defy in Sullengard to instruct him to give the villagers their share.
Thieves04.20: Defy told me that there will be a delay in giving the villagers of Sullengard their fair share for some unknown reason. I must report this to Umar at once.
Thieves04.30: Umar instructed me to talk to Defy once more.
Thieves04.35: Defy and his friends have vanished! Back to Umar ...
Thieves04.40: I told Umar about the disappearance of Defy and his men. But Umar didn't believe me and he even sent me back to find them. I better ask the villagers there.
Thieves04.50: There was a distressed man, whom just had his first child, who hinted to me of wherabouts of Defy and his men. I must report this to Umar once more.
Thieves04.60: With Sullengard running into financial trouble, Umar is enraged by Defy's traitorous way.
Thieves04.70: Umar gave me a task to give the mayor at least 50000 gold coins as the promised share for their living. After that, I'm instructed to report back to him.
Thieves04.75: Sullengard has been given their share of the gold and now it's time to revisit Umar.
Thieves04.80: At last, Sullengard can now sleep calmly and eat sufficiently with their finances restored.

sullengard_recover_items.10: I've agreed to help the armour shop owner, Zaccheria investigate the theft of his shop's entire inventory.
sullengard_recover_items.20: Zaccheria suggested that I should start my investigation by speaking with Gaelian from the Briwerra family.
sullengard_recover_items.30: I spoke with Gaelian from the Briwerra family and I suspect that he had nothing to do with this crime.
sullengard_recover_items.40:
I spoke with Prowling Arantxa, a thief in the Sullengard tavern basement and she informed me that the 'lost traveler' recently tried to sell her some items that she recgonized as belonging to Zaccheria.
I should speak with the 'lost traveler'.
sullengard_recover_items.50: I had paid the 'lost traveler' in exchange for the location of Zaccheria's stolen items. He told me that he had hidden them on the eastern boundaries of town.
sullengard_recover_items.60: I found the stolen items and should return to Zaccheria with them.
sullengard_recover_items.70: Zaccheria was very happy that I was able to return his items to him. He paid me a very nice reward in gold.
